name: Nederlandse feestdagen en gedenkdagen (1966–2030)
title: Nederlandse feestdagen en gedenkdagen (1966–2030)
description: Dutch public holidays (officiële feestdagen) and observance days (gedenkdagen) from 1966 through 2030, in two categories: PUBLIC (Nieuwjaarsdag, Goede Vrijdag, Eerste paasdag, Tweede paasdag, Koningsdag [from 2014, previously Koninginnedag], Bevrijdingsdag [every five years, statutory non-working day per Atw], Hemelvaartsdag, Eerste Pinksterdag, Tweede Pinksterdag, Eerste Kerstdag, Tweede Kerstdag) and OPTIONAL (Bevrijdingsdag annually from 1982 — widely observed but only a statutory non-working day every five years per the Algemene termijnenwet). Generated from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) algorithmic implementation in holidays/countries/netherlands.py. Multilingual names in Dutch (nl, default/native), English (en_US), Frisian (fy), Thai (th), and Ukrainian (uk) per Netherlands.supported_languages = ('en_US','fy','nl','th','uk'). Koningsdag observed-date rule: if 27 April falls on Sunday, observed on the preceding Saturday (SUN_TO_PREV_SAT, from 1980 onward); Koninginnedag (pre-2014, 30 April) used SUN_TO_NEXT_MON. Easter-derived dates use the Western Christian computation. Native Dutch characters preserved via ensure_ascii=False.

meta.title: Nederlandse feestdagen en gedenkdagen (1966–2030) - Gratis downloaden
meta.description: Dutch public holidays (officiële feestdagen) and observance days (gedenkdagen) from 1966 through 2030, in two categories: PUBLIC (Nieuwjaarsdag, Goede Vrijdag, Eerste paasdag, Tweede paasdag, Koningsdag [from 2014, previously Koninginnedag], Bevrijdingsdag [every five years, statutory non-working day per Atw], Hemelvaartsdag, Eerste Pinksterdag, Tweede Pinksterdag, Eerste Kerstdag, Tweede Kerstdag) and OPTIONAL (Bevrijdingsdag annually from 1982 — widely observed but only a statutory non-working day every five years per the Algemene termijnenwet). Generated from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) algorithmic implementation in holidays/countries/netherlands.py. Multilingual names in Dutch (nl, default/native), English (en_US), Frisian (fy), Thai (th), and Ukrainian (uk) per Netherlands.supported_languages = ('en_US','fy','nl','th','uk'). Koningsdag observed-date rule: if 27 April falls on Sunday, observed on the preceding Saturday (SUN_TO_PREV_SAT, from 1980 onward); Koninginnedag (pre-2014, 30 April) used SUN_TO_NEXT_MON. Easter-derived dates use the Western Christian computation. Native Dutch characters preserved via ensure_ascii=False. Bevat 711 records. Downloaden in Excel, CSV, PDF formaat.
